transcript: If you're new to Claude Code, then you need to install these five free plugins to instantly 10x your setup. The first is claude-mem, which gives Claude memory across every session, so it'll remember your projects and your files without you ever having to re-explain a thing. The second's called find-skills. Just tell it what you're building, and it'll search its entire library of over 100,000 skills to find the best ones, and even install them for you. The third is anydoc, which turns your PowerPoint, Excel, and Word sheets into totally clean markdown files, allowing your AI to instantly read them while consuming significantly fewer tokens. The fourth is Claude Code setup, which is an official Anthropic plugin that scans your entire codebase, and recommends the best hooks, skills, and sub-agents, not to mention MCP servers that fit your project, and it'll do this while removing all unnecessary fluff. And finally, there's Agent Skills, which is a pack of 24 skills to let you vibe code like a real senior engineer, built by the former AI engineering director at Google, which covers your entire dev cycle from start to finish, and it helps you activate the right skill at each specific stage of coding, all on its own. So if you want to try this yourselves, just comment "Claude" down below, and I'll send you the link directly.
